title: Jenazah pegawai AKPS selesai bedah siasat, dibawa pulang ke Tumpat - Saifuddin Nasution
summary: MACHANG - Jenazah pegawai Agensi Kawalan dan Perlindungan Sempadan Malaysia (AKPS) yang dipercayai dibunuh suaminya di Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, telah selesai menjalani bedah siasat pagi tadi sebelum dibawa pulang ke Tumpat untuk urusan pengebumian.Menteri Dalam Negeri, Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution I

title_en: The body of the AKPS officer after autopsy, taken home to Tumpat - Saifuddin Nasution
summary_en: MACHANG - The body of a Malaysian Border Protection and Control Agency (AKPS) officer who was allegedly murdered by her husband in Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, has been autopsyd this morning before being taken home to Tumpat for burial.

title: Jenazah pegawai AKPS maut ditikam suami dibawa pulang ke Tumpat hari ini
summary: MACHANG: Jenazah pegawai Agensi Kawalan dan Perlindungan Sempadan (AKPS), Norhazwani Ibrahim, 35, yang ditemukan maut dipercayai ditikam suaminya di Kompleks Perumahan Awam dekat Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, kelmarin, akan dibawa pulang ke Tumpat hari ini. Menteri Dalam Negeri, Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasut

title_en: The body of the AKPS officer killed by her husband's stabbed was taken home to Tumpat today.
summary_en: MACHANG: The body of the Border Control and Protection Agency (AKPS) officer, Norhazwani Ibrahim, 35, who was found dead allegedly by her husband at a public housing complex near Nilai, Negeri Sembilan yesterday will be brought home to Tumpat today.
